units.detail: Preserve original olive GREEN pointed hood with WHITE HAND emblem, green orc skin, olive leather tunic and brown straps/pouches/wraps, iron forearm/knee guards, dark boots; white-arrow quiver. Short dagger low on one side; free hand low forward. Lean into fast pursuit with front knee bent and back leg extending, head tucked well BELOW shoulder line, face a black hood shadow with at most chin edge visible.

Short broad curved steel sword LOW on one side, opposite empty arm reaching forward as he charges; torso tips forward, front leg reaches and rear leg pushes. Crown/hair TOP dominates head, eyes and upper face entirely obscured; only small nose/chin fragment.
